div.span:
command_generator.cpp
build_lpddr5_bank_generated_artifacts(
GeneratorGeometry geometry,
int context_tokens,
uint64_t page_size_bytes)

Local setup
derive:
- L
- dhead
- heads_per_hbm
- channel_count
- dtype_bytes
- n_mac
- partition_size
build:
- LpddrGeometry gs

Create empty command groups
- cmd_score_wrgb
- cmd_score_mac
- cmd_score_mvsb
- cmd_sfm
- cmd_context_mvgb
- cmd_context_mac
- cmd_context_mvsb
- valid_channels

attention(itr, per_itr_channels)
one generator pass per head iteration

Score-side groups
PIM_WR_GB -> KvKey
PIM_MAC_AB -> KvKey
PIM_MV_SB -> KvKey

Context-side groups
PIM_MV_GB -> KvValue
PIM_MAC_AB -> KvValue
PIM_MV_SB -> KvValue

Helpers
make_kv_command(...)
make_kv_address(...)
structs:
- LogicalCommand
- LogicalKvAddress

Split heads across iterations
num_itr =
ceil(heads_per_hbm / valid_channel_limit)
for itr:
attention(itr, per_itr_channels)

Build barrier commands
CommandList barrier
PIM_BARRIER per local channel

Assemble total_cmd
paired path:
for i += 2
interleave:
- score write
- score MAC
- score move
- softmax
- context move
- context MAC
- context move
- barrier

Odd tail handling
if num_itr % 2 != 0
append final non-paired iteration

Create RepresentativeKvLayout
set:
- geometry
- context_tokens
- page_size_bytes
- partition_size_units
- value_base_addr

For each KV command
legacy_physical_address(layout, target, kv_address)

register_page(...)
collect touched physical pages
for key and value separately

finalize_dense_layout(...)
sort pages by:
- layer_idx
- head_itr
- local_channel
- physical_page
build:
- physical_pages
- dense_page_by_physical_page
- pages_per_layer
